newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Jackin to issue 97 mln shares in IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Jackin to issue 97 mln shares in IPO - sources.

text.p: Magnetic data storage products manufacturer Jackin International Holdings Ltd is expected to issue about 97 million shares at HK$1.05 per share, market sources said on Thursday.
The proceeds are expected to be used to fund expansion in the company's production and software divisions, the sources said.
The company is expected to list the shares in late November with Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd seen as the sponsor of the issue, they added.

Jackin posted a profit of HK$25 million for the year ended December 31, 1995, up from HK$19.4 million in 1994. Its turnover increased to HK$333.6 million in 1995 from HK$252.6 million in 1994, the sources said.
The company posted a profit of HK$27 million for the first five months of 1996 on turnover of HK$180 million, they added.
